meaning.en: Three staggered dots rise while their shadows narrow.
meaning.zh-Hans: 三个圆点错峰跳起，地面投影同步收窄。

summary.en: Three staggered dots rise while their shadows narrow. The canvas is a deterministic motion demonstration, not a connected control.
summary.zh-Hans: 三个圆点错峰跳起，地面投影同步收窄。 画布为确定性动效演示，未接入真实业务控件。

ask.en: Build shadow dots loader for my interface. Preserve the motion parameters below and adapt the colors to my product.
ask.zh-Hans: 为我的界面实现「投影跳点加载」，保留下列运动参数并适配产品配色。

use.en: Use for focused interface feedback; see ADP for complete Agent interaction components.
use.zh-Hans: 用于局部界面反馈；完整 Agent 交互组件参见 ADP。

en: Each dot repeats every 800ms with a one-third-cycle phase offset; rise 36px, radius 7px, shadow scale 1 to 0.55.
Reference canvas: 539×208 CSS pixels; preview cycle 4800ms. Scale uniformly for other sizes.
Keep motion deterministic when scrubbing. Honor reduced motion with a stable keyframe, preserve readable labels, and do not depend on color alone.
zh-Hans: 每个圆点以 800ms 循环，相位依次错开三分之一周期；上移 36px，半径 7px，投影横向从 1 缩至 0.55。
参考画布为 539×208 CSS 像素，预览总周期 4800ms；其他尺寸保持等比缩放。
拖动时间轴时使用确定性运动。减少动态时保留稳定关键帧，保证标签可读，不仅依赖颜色表达状态。

useCases: Indicate a short wait with separate dots and their ground shadows.
limitations: This does not describe measurable completion; do not label it as a percentage.
integration: Show it while a real task is pending and replace it with a meaningful result or error.

useCases: 使用圆点及地面投影表示短暂等待。
limitations: 它不表达可测量的完成程度，不应标注为百分比。
integration: 在真实任务等待期间展示，并在结束时切换为明确结果或错误。

meaning.en: Eleven bars breathe in a traveling wave.
meaning.zh-Hans: 十一根条柱以行进波节奏起伏。

summary.en: Eleven bars breathe in a traveling wave. The canvas is a deterministic motion demonstration, not a connected control.
summary.zh-Hans: 十一根条柱以行进波节奏起伏。 画布为确定性动效演示，未接入真实业务控件。

ask.en: Build equalizer loader for my interface. Preserve the motion parameters below and adapt the colors to my product.
ask.zh-Hans: 为我的界面实现「均衡器加载」，保留下列运动参数并适配产品配色。

use.en: Use for focused interface feedback; see ADP for complete Agent interaction components.
use.zh-Hans: 用于局部界面反馈；完整 Agent 交互组件参见 ADP。

en: Use eleven 7px-wide bars at 13px pitch, a 1200ms sinusoidal cycle, and 0.6rad phase offset; height 18–88px.
Reference canvas: 539×208 CSS pixels; preview cycle 4800ms. Scale uniformly for other sizes.
Keep motion deterministic when scrubbing. Honor reduced motion with a stable keyframe, preserve readable labels, and do not depend on color alone.
zh-Hans: 十一根条柱宽 7px、间距步长 13px，以 1200ms 正弦周期起伏，相邻相位差 0.6 弧度，高度约 18–88px。
参考画布为 539×208 CSS 像素，预览总周期 4800ms；其他尺寸保持等比缩放。
拖动时间轴时使用确定性运动。减少动态时保留稳定关键帧，保证标签可读，不仅依赖颜色表达状态。

useCases: Suggest ongoing processing through a rhythm of changing bars.
limitations: The visual rhythm is not a recording or a measurement of actual audio.
integration: Connect visibility to task state; provide a text status when the bars carry important meaning.

useCases: 通过条柱节奏表达持续处理状态。
limitations: 视觉节奏不代表录音，也不代表真实音频测量。
integration: 让显示状态跟随任务；如果条柱承担重要含义，另提供文字状态。

meaning.en: A continuous triangular outline draws around a quiet center dot.
meaning.zh-Hans: 三角轮廓围绕静止中心点连续绘制。

summary.en: A continuous triangular outline draws around a quiet center dot. The canvas is a deterministic motion demonstration, not a connected control.
summary.zh-Hans: 三角轮廓围绕静止中心点连续绘制。 画布为确定性动效演示，未接入真实业务控件。

ask.en: Build triangle path loader for my interface. Preserve the motion parameters below and adapt the colors to my product.
ask.zh-Hans: 为我的界面实现「三角描边加载」，保留下列运动参数并适配产品配色。

use.en: Use for focused interface feedback; see ADP for complete Agent interaction components.
use.zh-Hans: 用于局部界面反馈；完整 Agent 交互组件参见 ADP。

en: Draw a closed three-point 330px perimeter with a 4px round stroke over 2400ms using cubic ease-out; reset at the cycle boundary.
Reference canvas: 539×208 CSS pixels; preview cycle 4800ms. Scale uniformly for other sizes.
Keep motion deterministic when scrubbing. Honor reduced motion with a stable keyframe, preserve readable labels, and do not depend on color alone.
zh-Hans: 闭合三角形周长约 330px，使用 4px 圆头描边，在 2400ms 内以三次减速曲线绘制，周期边界归零。
参考画布为 539×208 CSS 像素，预览总周期 4800ms；其他尺寸保持等比缩放。
拖动时间轴时使用确定性运动。减少动态时保留稳定关键帧，保证标签可读，不仅依赖颜色表达状态。

useCases: Express an indeterminate wait through a repeating triangular path.
limitations: A completed outline is a visual cycle, not proof that work has completed.
integration: Keep the loader separate from task completion and provide a stable reduced-motion state.

useCases: 通过三角路径的重复描边表达不确定等待。
limitations: 轮廓画完只表示一次视觉循环，不代表任务完成。
integration: 将加载循环与任务完成事件分离，并提供稳定的减少动态状态。

meaning.en: Three tiles take turns moving into the empty corner of a square.
meaning.zh-Hans: 三个方块依次滑入正方形的空缺角。

summary.en: Three tiles take turns moving into the empty corner of a square. The canvas is a deterministic motion demonstration, not a connected control.
summary.zh-Hans: 三个方块依次滑入正方形的空缺角。 画布为确定性动效演示，未接入真实业务控件。

ask.en: Build sliding tile loader for my interface. Preserve the motion parameters below and adapt the colors to my product.
ask.zh-Hans: 为我的界面实现「滑块轮换加载」，保留下列运动参数并适配产品配色。

use.en: Use for focused interface feedback; see ADP for complete Agent interaction components.
use.zh-Hans: 用于局部界面反馈；完整 Agent 交互组件参见 ADP。

en: Place three 27px tiles on four 38px-pitch slots; move one tile into the empty slot every 400ms with cubic ease-out.
Reference canvas: 539×208 CSS pixels; preview cycle 4800ms. Scale uniformly for other sizes.
Keep motion deterministic when scrubbing. Honor reduced motion with a stable keyframe, preserve readable labels, and do not depend on color alone.
zh-Hans: 在步长 38px 的四个槽位放置三个 27px 方块，每 400ms 以三次减速曲线将一个方块移入空槽。
参考画布为 539×208 CSS 像素，预览总周期 4800ms；其他尺寸保持等比缩放。
拖动时间轴时使用确定性运动。减少动态时保留稳定关键帧，保证标签可读，不仅依赖颜色表达状态。

useCases: Show continuous activity through tiles moving into an empty slot.
limitations: The moving tiles should not look like controls that the user must arrange.
integration: Keep the pattern decorative and tie its lifecycle to the real pending state.

useCases: 通过方块滑入空位来表示持续活动。
limitations: 移动方块不应被误认为需要用户排列的控件。
integration: 保持图案的装饰属性，并让它的生命周期跟随真实等待状态。

meaning.en: A soft highlight circles the perimeter of a processing panel.
meaning.zh-Hans: 柔和亮光沿处理面板边框环绕。

summary.en: A soft highlight circles the perimeter of a processing panel. The canvas is a deterministic motion demonstration, not a connected control.
summary.zh-Hans: 柔和亮光沿处理面板边框环绕。 画布为确定性动效演示，未接入真实业务控件。

ask.en: Build border orbit loader for my interface. Preserve the motion parameters below and adapt the colors to my product.
ask.zh-Hans: 为我的界面实现「边框巡光加载」，保留下列运动参数并适配产品配色。

use.en: Use for focused interface feedback; see ADP for complete Agent interaction components.
use.zh-Hans: 用于局部界面反馈；完整 Agent 交互组件参见 ADP。

en: Keep a 187×86px panel fixed; rotate a linear stroke gradient through 360 degrees over 2400ms, with 5px stroke clipped to an 18px rounded perimeter.
Reference canvas: 539×208 CSS pixels; preview cycle 4800ms. Scale uniformly for other sizes.
Keep motion deterministic when scrubbing. Honor reduced motion with a stable keyframe, preserve readable labels, and do not depend on color alone.
zh-Hans: 固定 187×86px 面板，在 2400ms 内将描边渐变方向旋转 360 度，5px 描边裁切到圆角 18px 的边界。
参考画布为 539×208 CSS 像素，预览总周期 4800ms；其他尺寸保持等比缩放。
拖动时间轴时使用确定性运动。减少动态时保留稳定关键帧，保证标签可读，不仅依赖颜色表达状态。

useCases: Emphasize a processing panel without moving its content.
limitations: The highlight must remain distinguishable from keyboard focus and validation outlines.
integration: Animate a decorative perimeter separately from focus styling and task status.

useCases: 在不移动内容的情况下强调正在处理的面板。
limitations: 巡光需要与键盘焦点边框和校验边框保持区别。
integration: 将装饰边框动画与焦点样式、任务状态分开维护。

meaning.en: A bright trace scans an angular waveform over a muted track.
meaning.zh-Hans: 亮色描线扫过低对比心电折线。

summary.en: A bright trace scans an angular waveform over a muted track. The canvas is a deterministic motion demonstration, not a connected control.
summary.zh-Hans: 亮色描线扫过低对比心电折线。 画布为确定性动效演示，未接入真实业务控件。

ask.en: Build heartbeat trace loader for my interface. Preserve the motion parameters below and adapt the colors to my product.
ask.zh-Hans: 为我的界面实现「心电描线加载」，保留下列运动参数并适配产品配色。

use.en: Use for focused interface feedback; see ADP for complete Agent interaction components.
use.zh-Hans: 用于局部界面反馈；完整 Agent 交互组件参见 ADP。

en: Reveal a fixed 209px-wide waveform from left to right in 1600ms, using a 3px rounded stroke, then reset.
Reference canvas: 539×208 CSS pixels; preview cycle 4800ms. Scale uniformly for other sizes.
Keep motion deterministic when scrubbing. Honor reduced motion with a stable keyframe, preserve readable labels, and do not depend on color alone.
zh-Hans: 固定宽度 209px 的波形使用 3px 圆头描边，在 1600ms 内从左向右线性揭示后归零。
参考画布为 539×208 CSS 像素，预览总周期 4800ms；其他尺寸保持等比缩放。
拖动时间轴时使用确定性运动。减少动态时保留稳定关键帧，保证标签可读，不仅依赖颜色表达状态。

useCases: Signal continuing activity with a scanning angular line.
limitations: The reference is decorative and is not a medical measurement or health indicator.
integration: Accompany it with a plain task status and stop the scan when the actual task ends.

useCases: 用扫过折线的描线表示持续活动。
limitations: 该参考为装饰效果，不是医疗测量或健康指标。
integration: 配合清楚的任务状态文字，并在实际任务结束时停止扫线。

meaning.en: A slider track stretches and compresses as its thumb approaches the upper bound.
meaning.zh-Hans: 滑块接近上界时轨道拉伸并压扁。

summary.en: A slider track stretches and compresses as its thumb approaches the upper bound. The canvas is a deterministic motion demonstration, not a connected control.
summary.zh-Hans: 滑块接近上界时轨道拉伸并压扁。 画布为确定性动效演示，未接入真实业务控件。

ask.en: Build elastic volume feedback for my interface. Preserve the motion parameters below and adapt the colors to my product.
ask.zh-Hans: 为我的界面实现「音量弹性边界」，保留下列运动参数并适配产品配色。

use.en: Use for focused interface feedback; see ADP for complete Agent interaction components.
use.zh-Hans: 用于局部界面反馈；完整 Agent 交互组件参见 ADP。

en: Use a 216×38px track; drive the thumb on a 2400ms cycle and map the final 15% to 18px track extension and 4.5px height compression.
Reference canvas: 539×208 CSS pixels; preview cycle 4800ms. Scale uniformly for other sizes.
Keep motion deterministic when scrubbing. Honor reduced motion with a stable keyframe, preserve readable labels, and do not depend on color alone.
zh-Hans: 轨道为 216×38px，滑块以 2400ms 周期移动，最后 15% 区间映射至 18px 延伸和 4.5px 高度压缩。
参考画布为 539×208 CSS 像素，预览总周期 4800ms；其他尺寸保持等比缩放。
拖动时间轴时使用确定性运动。减少动态时保留稳定关键帧，保证标签可读，不仅依赖颜色表达状态。

useCases: Make a slider reaching its upper bound feel physically resistant.
limitations: An elastic track must not imply values outside the actual allowed range.
integration: Clamp the stored value while driving visual resistance from pointer overshoot; support keyboard adjustment.

useCases: 让滑块到达上界时呈现阻力感。
limitations: 弹性轨道不能让用户误认为可以选择范围之外的数值。
integration: 限制真实保存值，仅用指针越界驱动视觉阻力，并支持键盘调整。

meaning.en: A hold gesture fills a pill and perimeter ring before switching to confirmation.
meaning.zh-Hans: 长按过程中胶囊与外围进度环同步填满后切换确认状态。

summary.en: A hold gesture fills a pill and perimeter ring before switching to confirmation. The canvas is a deterministic motion demonstration, not a connected control.
summary.zh-Hans: 长按过程中胶囊与外围进度环同步填满后切换确认状态。 画布为确定性动效演示，未接入真实业务控件。

ask.en: Build hold confirmation progress for my interface. Preserve the motion parameters below and adapt the colors to my product.
ask.zh-Hans: 为我的界面实现「长按确认进度」，保留下列运动参数并适配产品配色。

use.en: Use for focused interface feedback; see ADP for complete Agent interaction components.
use.zh-Hans: 用于局部界面反馈；完整 Agent 交互组件参见 ADP。

en: Preview: wait 500ms, fill over 1400ms, hold confirmation until 3400ms, then return to idle until the 4800ms loop restarts. In a real control use pointer capture, cancel on release, and offer keyboard hold or an explicit confirm alternative.
Reference canvas: 539×208 CSS pixels; preview cycle 4800ms. Scale uniformly for other sizes.
Keep motion deterministic when scrubbing. Honor reduced motion with a stable keyframe, preserve readable labels, and do not depend on color alone.
zh-Hans: 预览先等待 500ms，在 1400ms 内填充，确认状态保留至 3400ms，随后回到空闲态，4800ms 开启下一循环。真实控件需捕获指针，松开即取消，支持键盘长按或明确的确认替代操作。
参考画布为 539×208 CSS 像素，预览总周期 4800ms；其他尺寸保持等比缩放。
拖动时间轴时使用确定性运动。减少动态时保留稳定关键帧，保证标签可读，不仅依赖颜色表达状态。

useCases: Communicate deliberate hold-to-confirm progress before a consequential action.
limitations: A visual progress loop is not an authorization decision or a completed operation.
integration: Capture the hold, cancel on release or interruption, and send the action only after the host confirmation rule passes.

useCases: 在重要操作前表达需要持续按住的确认进度。
limitations: 视觉进度循环不是授权决定，也不代表操作完成。
integration: 捕获长按，在松开或中断时取消，仅在宿主确认规则通过后提交动作。

meaning.en: A traveling selection bubble keeps a shrinking liquid bridge to its origin.
meaning.zh-Hans: 移动选中气泡与起点之间保留逐渐收窄的液态连接。

summary.en: A traveling selection bubble keeps a shrinking liquid bridge to its origin. The canvas is a deterministic motion demonstration, not a connected control.
summary.zh-Hans: 移动选中气泡与起点之间保留逐渐收窄的液态连接。 画布为确定性动效演示，未接入真实业务控件。

ask.en: Build fluid tab bridge for my interface. Preserve the motion parameters below and adapt the colors to my product.
ask.zh-Hans: 为我的界面实现「液态标签桥接」，保留下列运动参数并适配产品配色。

use.en: Use for focused interface feedback; see ADP for complete Agent interaction components.
use.zh-Hans: 用于局部界面反馈；完整 Agent 交互组件参见 ADP。

en: Move the 22px-radius bubble over 180px with a cosine ease over 2400ms; reduce bridge thickness from 24px to zero as distance increases.
Reference canvas: 539×208 CSS pixels; preview cycle 4800ms. Scale uniformly for other sizes.
Keep motion deterministic when scrubbing. Honor reduced motion with a stable keyframe, preserve readable labels, and do not depend on color alone.
zh-Hans: 半径 22px 的气泡以 2400ms 余弦曲线往返移动 180px，液态连接厚度随距离增加从 24px 收窄至零。
参考画布为 539×208 CSS 像素，预览总周期 4800ms；其他尺寸保持等比缩放。
拖动时间轴时使用确定性运动。减少动态时保留稳定关键帧，保证标签可读，不仅依赖颜色表达状态。

useCases: Keep visual continuity while a selected tab moves away from its origin.
limitations: The liquid bridge is decorative; selected tab and panel semantics must stay explicit.
integration: Drive the visual bubble from the active tab, preserve arrow-key navigation, and handle fast changes.

useCases: 在选中标签离开原位置时保持视觉连续性。
limitations: 液态连接是装饰，选中标签与内容面板的语义仍需明确。
integration: 让气泡跟随当前标签，保留方向键导航，并处理快速切换。

meaning.en: A marquee accelerates and tilts with its instantaneous travel speed.
meaning.zh-Hans: 文字跑马灯随行进速度变化加速并产生倾斜。

summary.en: A marquee accelerates and tilts with its instantaneous travel speed. The canvas is a deterministic motion demonstration, not a connected control.
summary.zh-Hans: 文字跑马灯随行进速度变化加速并产生倾斜。 画布为确定性动效演示，未接入真实业务控件。

ask.en: Build velocity marquee for my interface. Preserve the motion parameters below and adapt the colors to my product.
ask.zh-Hans: 为我的界面实现「速度响应跑马灯」，保留下列运动参数并适配产品配色。

use.en: Use for focused interface feedback; see ADP for complete Agent interaction components.
use.zh-Hans: 用于局部界面反馈；完整 Agent 交互组件参见 ADP。

en: Translate a repeated 450px unit with position 450p + 60 sin(2πp) over 4800ms; derive skew from instantaneous velocity. Connect to smoothed scroll velocity in production, clamp skew, and stop under reduced motion.
Reference canvas: 539×208 CSS pixels; preview cycle 4800ms. Scale uniformly for other sizes.
Keep motion deterministic when scrubbing. Honor reduced motion with a stable keyframe, preserve readable labels, and do not depend on color alone.
zh-Hans: 以 4800ms 周期按 450p + 60 sin(2πp) 位移重复的 450px 单元，倾斜取自瞬时速度。实际接入平滑后的滚动速度，限制倾斜幅度，并在减少动态时停用。
参考画布为 539×208 CSS 像素，预览总周期 4800ms；其他尺寸保持等比缩放。
拖动时间轴时使用确定性运动。减少动态时保留稳定关键帧，保证标签可读，不仅依赖颜色表达状态。

useCases: Create expressive headline movement that responds to changing travel speed.
limitations: Do not use a moving marquee as the only way to read essential information.
integration: Smooth and limit the input velocity; offer a stationary reduced-motion presentation.

useCases: 让富有表现力的标题运动响应行进速度变化。
limitations: 不要让移动文字成为阅读重要信息的唯一途径。
integration: 平滑并限制输入速度，在减少动态时提供静止呈现。

meaning.en: Reading progress fills three tracks and passes emphasis to the next chapter.
meaning.zh-Hans: 阅读进度依次填满三个轨道，并将强调状态交给下一章节。

summary.en: Reading progress fills three tracks and passes emphasis to the next chapter. The canvas is a deterministic motion demonstration, not a connected control.
summary.zh-Hans: 阅读进度依次填满三个轨道，并将强调状态交给下一章节。 画布为确定性动效演示，未接入真实业务控件。

ask.en: Build chapter progress handoff for my interface. Preserve the motion parameters below and adapt the colors to my product.
ask.zh-Hans: 为我的界面实现「章节进度交接」，保留下列运动参数并适配产品配色。

use.en: Use for focused interface feedback; see ADP for complete Agent interaction components.
use.zh-Hans: 用于局部界面反馈；完整 Agent 交互组件参见 ADP。

en: Divide a 4800ms preview into three equal chapters with 101×5px progress tracks; fill linearly and move the active chapter emphasis at each boundary. Bind actual progress to section offsets with resize recalculation.
Reference canvas: 539×208 CSS pixels; preview cycle 4800ms. Scale uniformly for other sizes.
Keep motion deterministic when scrubbing. Honor reduced motion with a stable keyframe, preserve readable labels, and do not depend on color alone.
zh-Hans: 4800ms 预览等分为三个章节，进度轨道为 101×5px，线性填充并在章节边界交接强调状态。实际阅读进度绑定区块位置，并在尺寸变化后重算。
参考画布为 539×208 CSS 像素，预览总周期 4800ms；其他尺寸保持等比缩放。
拖动时间轴时使用确定性运动。减少动态时保留稳定关键帧，保证标签可读，不仅依赖颜色表达状态。

useCases: Show which chapter is active and how reading advances through a document.
limitations: Reading progress must follow real sections rather than elapsed playback time.
integration: Measure chapter positions after layout changes and keep navigation usable without animation.

useCases: 展示当前章节及文档阅读推进情况。
limitations: 阅读进度应跟随真实章节，而不是播放经过的时间。
integration: 在布局变化后重新测量章节位置，并让导航在无动画时也可使用。

meaning.en: A broad radial sheen moves inside a clipped translucent panel.
meaning.zh-Hans: 大面积径向高光在裁切的半透明面板内部移动。

summary.en: A broad radial sheen moves inside a clipped translucent panel. The canvas is a deterministic motion demonstration, not a connected control.
summary.zh-Hans: 大面积径向高光在裁切的半透明面板内部移动。 画布为确定性动效演示，未接入真实业务控件。

ask.en: Build glass shine tracking for my interface. Preserve the motion parameters below and adapt the colors to my product.
ask.zh-Hans: 为我的界面实现「玻璃高光追踪」，保留下列运动参数并适配产品配色。

use.en: Use for focused interface feedback; see ADP for complete Agent interaction components.
use.zh-Hans: 用于局部界面反馈；完整 Agent 交互组件参见 ADP。

en: Clip a 115px-radius gradient to a 220×102px panel with 22px corners; move the highlight on a 2400ms ellipse. In production use normalized pointer coordinates and a static sheen on touch devices.
Reference canvas: 539×208 CSS pixels; preview cycle 4800ms. Scale uniformly for other sizes.
Keep motion deterministic when scrubbing. Honor reduced motion with a stable keyframe, preserve readable labels, and do not depend on color alone.
zh-Hans: 将半径 115px 的渐变裁切在 220×102px、圆角 22px 的面板内，高光以 2400ms 椭圆轨迹移动。实际使用归一化指针坐标，触屏采用静态高光。
参考画布为 539×208 CSS 像素，预览总周期 4800ms；其他尺寸保持等比缩放。
拖动时间轴时使用确定性运动。减少动态时保留稳定关键帧，保证标签可读，不仅依赖颜色表达状态。

useCases: Add a pointer-responsive sheen to a glass-like panel.
limitations: The sheen must not lower text contrast or imply the panel is a draggable control.
integration: Map the pointer into panel coordinates, clip the highlight, and use a static alternative for touch input.

useCases: 为玻璃质感面板增加跟随指针的高光。
limitations: 高光不能降低文字对比度，也不应让面板看起来像可拖动控件。
integration: 将指针映射到面板坐标，裁切高光，并为触屏提供静态替代。
